responsibility: This header declares selected helper routines exported by the OpenMP lowering implementation for use by related passes. Its interface centers on reduction initialization support, dummy member-access construction for lowered data-sharing records, and the walker helper that detects combined for constructs during OpenMP lowering and SIMD-clone preparation.
same_name_distinction: Exports only a small subset of lowering helpers—reduction initialization, dummy member-access construction, and combined-for detection—for use by related code such as SIMD cloning. Unlike gcc/omp-low.cc, it is not the lowering pass implementation and does not define omp_context or the lowering traversal.
